request_payload.experiment_Name: OpenRouter model price-performance sweep: CODE-ACCORD full document (v8)
request_payload.experiment_Description: One-run-per-case model screening on the CODE-ACCORD full-PDF-text dataset. Uses the same seven OpenRouter models as exp_088: GPT-5.4 as the prior-result anchor; GPT-6 Astra and GPT-6.1 Sol to test OpenAI's current flagship and its claimed near-flagship lower-cost option; Claude Opus 5.5 and Gemini 4 Argon as updated frontier comparisons; Qwen 3.6 Plus as a prior high-scoring value model; and MiniMax M3.1 Flash as a lower-cost newer model. Provider performance claims are hypotheses to test, not assumed results. Compare exact-match rates separately by dataset, and report unscored outputs, input/output tokens, pipeline time, and estimated API cost/cost per correct result using a dated OpenRouter price snapshot. One run per case/model is descriptive screening, not a stable model ranking. The full-PDF dataset has 292 records; this configuration filters to the 290 filenames in the expanded-passage reference set. CODE-ACCORD search terms are derived from each dataset question because the historical German value-key map does not support value='value'. The v8 pipeline extracts keyword-centered physical-line windows from the full-document text; it does not send every full document line to the model.
request_payload.question: Welcher konkrete Zahlen- oder Messwert wird in folgendem Satz gefordert: In buildings with a total useful floor area greater than 1000m2, automatic meter reading and data collection facilities should be installed.

One pipeline run per case/model is descriptive screening, not a stable model ranking; v17 may make a second LLM call during context expansion. The full-PDF dataset has 292 records; this configuration filters to the 290 filenames in the expanded-passage reference set. CODE-ACCORD questions guide chunk retrieval and are appended to the extraction prompt. The pipeline ranks full-document text and selects chunks, so the model's maximum context does not imply that every full PDF is sent verbatim in one call.
